QuestInfo.name: A Complicating Man
QuestInfo.0: To steal the Goddess Teardrop from the Queen of Ariant, Alpha and Beta had to make use of the area around #m322000000#. They turned to #b#p2420005##k for more advice.
QuestInfo.1: #p2420005# offered up the tale of #p2420015#, the master thief, who recently leaked his intentions to steal the Teardrop! Alpha and Beta rushed to stop him, and started with a #bgirl at a tea shop in #m322000000##k that claimed to be his friend.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta encountered a girl named #p2420012#, who worked with a pair of sisters, #p2420013# and #p2420014#. What is there connection to Phantom?

0.0: If it isn't the treasure hunter twins? Have you heard the juicy gossip? Apparently the #bMaster Thief, Phantom#k, has taken a liking to the Queen's blue jewel. He told her right to her face that he's going to steal it! Why aren't you squealing with delight, girl?
0.1: You don't know who Master Thief Phantom is? And you call yourselves treasure hunters? He's only the most elusive, and eligible, thief in the world! He's never failed.
0.2: He's especially popular around here, since he targets the rich and cruel. And this new jewel is just the sort of thing he'd go after. I'd pay to see the look on that slimy queen's face when he nabs it out from under her big fat nose.
0.3: You don't even know who he is, do you? Well, I'm sure you'll be a fan soon enough... except for the fact that he's after your treasure! And trust me, you do NOT have the brains to #r outwit Phantom#k! Hahahah, like, hahahaha, not even CLOSE.

yes.0: BUT! Maybe he'll come down here if you make him mad enough... then I can finally get that date. Tell you what, there are a bunch of weird #bsisters who work part-time at the western Ariant tea house#k. They're like the biggest Phantom fangirls I know. Go talk to them. Bring me that hunk!

1.0: Hiya, boss! What can I get you? Green tea? Jasmine tea? Cactus tea? ...Phantom tea? We don't have that... OH! You mean the thief guy? Are you here for vengeance?!

npc.0: I told you, there are a bunch of #bPhantom-chasing sisters who work part-time at the western Ariant tea house#k. Go... talk to them or whatever you do.
